candidate_ladder_frozen_before_any_scree.mechanism_motivating_the_ladder: the live-role diagnostic (disposable seeds, this session) found OP7's defender assignment is STICKY (can_change gated on lock<=0) and OP7 sets lock_defender=28. A freed defender's slot recruits ANOTHER agent via a fresh argmin the next time the trigger fires, so defenders ACCUMULATE across ticks rather than holding at a fixed count: measured 2.9 of 4 red agents defending on average at 4v4, only ~27% ever attacking blue's flag (blue_flag_pressure=0.163). Pole B/OP7 is ALREADY compact (defender_zone_frac=0.05, the SDSGenome floor) and already reactive (threat_radius=12.0) -- the 2v2 'compact/reactive' mechanism is already present. The actual defect is accumulation via a long lock, not zone width or trigger range. The ladder therefore targets lock_defender directly: a legal, already-validated SDSGenome overlay field (sds_genome.py INT_BOUNDS: 4-40), not a new profile field or reward shaping.

B2-1_lockdef10.rationale: moderate release: a defender returns to another role well before OP7's native 28-tick lock expires

B2-2_lockdef10_lockatk24.rationale: B2-1 plus stickier committed offense, so a released agent that becomes an attacker stays committed rather than flip-flopping

B2-3_lockdef6.rationale: a second dose-response point on the SAME single lever (more aggressive release), to see whether B2-1's direction holds before combining levers

candidate_ladder_frozen_before_any_scree.selection_rule: the FIRST candidate in the order B2-1, B2-2, B2-3 whose G_B2 clears LCB95>0 (with G_A already known to clear) is selected. Do not screen all three and cherry-pick the largest effect; do not select based on any later PPO/specialist result. If none passes, this ladder is exhausted and a further ladder requires its own freeze -- it does not authorize an unlimited search.
